title: Slow network in Bengaluru office
description: Users at Bengaluru site report very slow file transfers and video calls dropping since morning. Approx 6 users affected.
resolution_steps:
1. Check WAN link utilisation on the Bengaluru edge router.
2. Identify top talkers; look for backup jobs running in office hours.
3. Reschedule backup job to off-peak window.
4. Monitor link for 2 hours and confirm with site contact.

title: Account locked after failed logins
description: User s.khan locked out of AD account after multiple failed password attempts on Windows 11. Needs urgent access for HR work.
resolution_steps:
1. Verify user identity per security policy (manager + employee ID).
2. Unlock account in Active Directory Users and Computers.
3. Reset password and enforce change at next logon.
4. Advise on password manager to prevent recurrence.

title: Printer AST-5521 not printing
description: Shared printer AST-5521 on floor 40 shows jobs queued but nothing prints; panel displays no error.
resolution_steps:
1. Restart the print spooler service on the print server.
2. Clear stuck jobs from the queue.
3. Power-cycle the printer and reseat network cable.
4. Print test page; if failing, swap with spare unit and log RMA.

title: Tableau crashes on startup
description: After the latest update, Tableau crashes immediately on launch for user in Procurement on macOS 14. Event viewer shows faulting module.
resolution_steps:
1. Clear the application cache/user profile settings folder.
2. Repair-install the application from the software portal.
3. If crash persists, roll back to previous version.
4. Log a problem record referencing the faulting module for vendor.

title: Slow queries on HRMSDB since morning
description: Application team reports SAP GUI timeouts; DB HRMSDB CPU at high utilisation. A deployment happened last night.
resolution_steps:
1. Identify top queries by CPU/reads since the deployment.
2. Compare execution plans against pre-deployment baseline.
3. Update statistics / rebuild the affected index.
4. If regression confirmed, roll back the offending query change.

title: Endpoint flagged with malware on Windows 10
description: AV console flags trojan on Sales user's machine PRN-104; device auto-isolated from network.
resolution_steps:
1. Keep device isolated; collect AV detection details.
2. Run full offline scan and remove the detected threat.
3. Verify no lateral movement from the endpoint in EDR logs.
4. Re-image if persistence is suspected; restore user data from backup.

title: Cannot reach internal portal SAP GUI
description: Multiple users report SAP GUI unreachable from office LAN, browser shows DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN. Wi-Fi segment VLAN-20.
resolution_steps:
1. Verify DNS resolution with nslookup against corporate DNS.
2. Flush client DNS cache (ipconfig /flushdns).
3. Check VLAN VLAN-20 DNS forwarder configuration.
4. Raise change request to correct forwarder entry if wrong.

title: MFA token not received
description: User m.das does not receive MFA push/SMS on registered device after switching to a new phone. Cannot log in to any SSO app.
resolution_steps:

3. Guide user through re-enrolling the new device.
4. Test SSO login to one app and confirm closure.
